articles.summary:
Iran's Araghchi meets Omani counterpart in Muscat

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has met his Omani counterpart in the capital of Muscat.

"A constructive meeting today with my colleague @araghchi," Omani foreign minister Badr Albusaidi wrote in a post on X. "We reviewed the steady course of Oman–Iran relations and practical ways to deepen cooperation between our two countries."

"We also exchanged views on the latest diplomatic efforts underway to address regional challenges, and reaffirmed the importance of continued dialogue and consultation in support of de-escalation and peaceful solutions."

Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests
articles.summary:
Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced on Monday that he will keep his campaign promise to disband the New York Police Department's Strategic Response Group (SRG) and replace it with “de-escalation groups”. 

The armour-clad SRG is made up of 500 highly trained NYPD officers who have become infamous for their “crowd control tactics” and mass arrests during protests in New York City, where they use batons, tear gas, pepper spray and other “de-escalation” weapons on disruptive protesters. 

The group came under particular scrutiny during pro-Palestine protests during the height of Israel’s genocide in Gaza and campus protests led by the student movement that started at Columbia University.

Read more: Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests

archive.security_status_en: The regional security situation remains highly tense due to ongoing operations in the Gaza Strip, cross-border strikes in Lebanon, and Iranian drone activities targeting US forces in the Gulf. Political instability in Israel is further reflected in parliamentary disputes and heightened tensions in the West Bank.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické tlaky na Izrael ohledně humanitární pomoci v Gaze a zvýšenou ostražitost amerických sil v reakci na regionální útoky dronů.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further diplomatic pressure on Israel regarding humanitarian aid in Gaza and heightened vigilance by US forces in response to regional drone attacks are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Regionální napětí výrazně eskaluje kvůli přímé konfrontaci mezi Íránem a americkými silami v oblasti Perského zálivu a Hormuzského průlivu, kde byly hlášeny útoky na tankery a drony. V Izraeli a Gaze mezitím přetrvává vysoké bezpečnostní riziko, které podtrhují incidenty v Západním břehu a rostoucí mezinárodní tlak na humanitární přístup. Sýrie prochází křehkou fází s návratem milionů uprchlíků, zatímco EU obnovuje spolupráci s Damaškem.
archive.security_status_en: Regional tensions are escalating significantly due to direct confrontation between Iran and US forces in the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz, where tanker and drone attacks have been reported. Meanwhile, Israel and Gaza face persistent security risks underscored by West Bank incidents and mounting international pressure over humanitarian access. Syria is experiencing a fragile transition with the return of millions of refugees as the EU resumes cooperation with Damascus.
archive.forecast_cs: V následujících dnech lze očekávat další eskalaci napětí kolem Hormuzského průlivu v reakci na íránské aktivity proti americkým a komerčním cílům a zostřenou diplomatickou rétoriku ohledně Gazy.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further escalation of tensions around the Strait of Hormuz is expected in response to Iranian activities targeting US and commercial assets, alongside heightened diplomatic rhetoric over Gaza.
